code_block:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment

metadata:
  name: runs-as-root-demo-app
  namespace: scanner-benchmark
  labels:
    app: runs-as-root-demo-app

spec:
  replicas: 1

  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: runs-as-root-demo-app

  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: runs-as-root-demo-app

    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false

      securityContext:
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault

      containers:
        - name: demo-container
          image: nginx:1.25

          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 80
              protocol: TCP

          securityContext:
            # Deliberate benchmark misconfiguration:
            runAsNonRoot: false

            privileged: false
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true

            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL

          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi

            limits:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 256Mi

          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http

            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10

          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http

            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 20
